task.name: stack_cup_on_book
task.description: Use the left arm to pick up the cup and place it on top of the closed book.

substages.substage: 1. Move the left arm to approach and align with the cup.
2. Grasp the cup with the left arm.
3. Move the left arm to align with the closed book.
4. Release the gripper to place the cup on top of the closed book.
